soldier: Soldier head brown tinged with red, pronotum paler, abdomen pale brownish yellow. Head capsule rectangular, fontanelle slightly projecting. Antennae 14–15-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about 3 times segment 2. Compound eyes bulging. Labrum nearly circular, slightly longer than wide; lacinia of the maxilla with 12 marginal bristles; mandibles distinctly curved. Anterior margin of the pronotum V-shaped, with a U-shaped median incision, the posterior margin shallowly concave at the centre, the midline visible.
